name: dsh-wiki-notes
description: Read-only Markdown knowledge-base retrieval for DeepSeek Harness: one wiki_recall tool (search/page/list/overview/lint/draft) returning the matching section's full text with page-level citations, plus three knowledge-gateway tools (wiki_context / wiki_verify / wiki_observe) that delegate evidence judgement to the local LLM-Wiki Python pipeline. 中文：本地 Markdown 笔记库检索插件，一次调用返回命中小节正文与出处，另带健康检查与回写骨架；新增知识网关三工具（wiki_context / wiki_verify / wiki_observe），证据判定交给本地 Python 管线，插件只负责调用与错误隔离。
